messages:
Maya: Heads up — I just saw a dashboard for workspace `ws-42` show saved searches from `ws-99` after I quickly switched tabs.
Oliver: that's... not great. Any repro steps?
Maya: Open console, switch org dropdown fast, click Saved Searches. It briefly flashes results from previous org, then corrects. :eyes:
Luca: customer reported similar in Sentry earlier today — said "search results belonged to another customer". cc @Jeremy (PM)
Jeremy (PM): severity? PII risk?
Maya: seems metadata only (names of saved searches), not user PII. But could confuse billing/ops.
Oliver: my first guess: our client-side prefetcher + shared fetch headers. if `X-Workspace` header is kept in a module-scoped var and prefetch happens before dropdown update, requests go out with old header.
Jen (SRE): can you paste an example request trail? any logs with `X-Workspace` we can grep?
Maya: yeah — here's the browser network capture snippet:
```
GET /api/saved_searches?scope=ui
Host: console.redwood.ai
X-Workspace: ws-99
Accept: application/json
```
and 200ms later
```
GET /api/saved_searches?scope=ui
X-Workspace: ws-42
```
Oliver: exactly — two almost-simultaneous requests. prefetch triggered by route transition uses the stale module var.
Luca: code pointer: `src/ui/prefetcher/index.ts` stores `currentWorkspace` at module top and reused for in-flight requests.
Oliver: proposed quick fix: make prefetcher accept workspace param per-call and remove shared var. also add server-side assertion: verify `workspace` in token vs header, log mismatch as `audit:header-mismatch`.
Jen (SRE): rolling mitigation: disable SPA prefetch in prod flag `prefetch.enabled=false` for next 30m, add log alert if `audit:header-mismatch` > 0.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: set `prefetch.enabled=false` on prod-config at 3165032200 by Jen (SRE)
Jeremy (PM): timeline — can dev pick up fix today?
Oliver: I can PR the change now, test in staging, and ship a canary later today. Will also add unit that ensures fetch wrapper never reads module-scoped workspace.
Maya: thanks. also let's add a note in postmortem template about 'client-side entanglement' so infra teams watch for similar patterns.
Jen (SRE): creating incident ticket and paging list. I'll monitor logs and revert flag when we confirm.
